data.long_meaning: Ajitha is a Sanskrit name that is derived from the root word 'aji' meaning peace and 'tha' meaning to conquer. It is a name given to a girl who is believed to bring peace and victory in her life. The name Ajitha carries the meaning “Peace, Conqueror” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ajitha usually hope their child will grow to embody peace, conqueror and live with faith, good character and purpose.
